sentences.speaker: Teacher:
sentences.english: Yes, the people you live with are very important.
sentences.arabic: نعم، الأشخاص الذين تعيش معهم مهمون جدًا.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/the people you live with are very important.mp3

sentences.speaker: Teacher:
sentences.english: What do you think makes a good home?
sentences.arabic: ما الذي تعتقد أنه يجعل المنزل جيدًا؟
sentences.audio: assets/audio/What do you think makes a good home.mp3

sentences.speaker: Teacher:
sentences.english: I like my home because I can walk to school and to the store
sentences.arabic: أحب منزلي لأنني أستطيع المشي إلى المدرسة وإلى المتجر
sentences.audio: assets/audio/I like my home because I can walk to school and to the store.mp3

sentences.speaker: Marcus:
sentences.english: Right now, I think a good home is quiet.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/Right now, I think a good home is quiet.mp3

sentences.speaker: Teacher:
sentences.english: Sometimes I want to move, but my apartment is cheap.
sentences.arabic: أحيانًا أريد النقل، لكن شقتي رخيصة.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/Sometimes I want to move, but my apartment is cheap.mp3

sentences.speaker: Sophy:
sentences.english: I want three bathrooms, a big backyard, and a swimming pool.
sentences.arabic: أريد ثلاثة حمامات، فناء خلفي كبير، ومسبح.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/I want three bathrooms, a big backyard, and a swimming pool.mp3

sentences.speaker: Sophy:
sentences.english: And I want to be right next to the beach.
sentences.arabic: وأريد أن أكون بجانب الشاطئ مباشرة.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/And I want to be right next to the beach.mp3

sentences.speaker: Teacher:
sentences.english: I hope you can live in that home someday!
sentences.arabic: أتمنى أن تتمكن من العيش في ذلك المنزل يومًا ما!
sentences.audio: assets/audio/Well, I hope you can live in that home someday.mp3

sentences.speaker: Teacher:
sentences.english: There are many different reasons to choose a home.
sentences.arabic: هناك العديد من الأسباب المختلفة لاختيار منزل.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/There are many different reasons to choose a home.mp3
